name: Weekly Business Review
permissionsNotice: Bot Cabinet generates plans and packages. Hermes Desktop settings and connected-service permissions are applied by you. Passports are checklists, not locks.

members.name: Ops
members.responsibility: Gather approved metrics, project status, deadlines, and exceptions.
approvalActions: Ask before restarts or configuration changes
A person approves restarts, deletions, configuration changes, and external messages.
members.firstTest: Check two harmless status sources and produce a report without changing either system.

members.name: Researcher
members.responsibility: Act as Analyst and explain changes, gaps, and possible causes.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only document access when I provide files
approvalActions: A person makes legal, medical, financial, and policy decisions.
members.firstTest: Answer one narrow question using at least three approved sources and identify any unresolved conflict.

members.name: Chief of Staff
members.responsibility: Prepare the decision brief and surface capacity conflicts.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only access to approved planning documents and calendar information
approvalActions: Ask before changing a calendar, task, or shared record
A leader sets priorities, assigns people, and approves commitments and deadlines.
The Bot drafts agendas and follow-ups but does not contact people or change shared records without approval.
members.firstTest: Use sample updates from two projects to produce a one-page priority brief and a decision log for review.

members.name: Planner
members.responsibility: Turn approved decisions into owners, actions, and dates.
approvalActions: Do not assign people or commit dates without approval
Do not change an external task system without approval
A person approves assignments and deadlines.
members.firstTest: Create a two-week plan from one approved objective and identify every missing decision.

handoffOrder.action: Collect metrics, work status, and exceptions.
Explain movement and mark unreliable data.
Record approved priorities, owners, and dates.

approvalActions: Change a priority, assignment, deadline, or metric
Message a client or team member
Make a financial or personnel decision
